## Description

R19: The settle-phase skill documents the `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION: <question>]` marker for specification and design bodies and tells the agent to resolve every marker before it ends settle-phase.

R20: The plan-phase skill tells the agent to run `orchestra analyze <phase-slug>` before plan review and to refuse plan review while it exits 1.

R21: The execute-phase skill tells the agent to run `orchestra analyze <phase-slug> --stage close` after the closing verification and before the reviewer, and to refuse to start the reviewer while it exits 1.

## Approach

Edit `skills/settle-phase/SKILL.md` to define the `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION: <question>]` marker for specification and design bodies and to require resolving every marker before step 10. Edit `skills/plan-phase/SKILL.md` so the plan review gate runs `orchestra analyze <phase-slug>` first and refuses plan review while it exits 1. Edit `skills/execute-phase/SKILL.md` (or `references/phase-end.md`) so `orchestra analyze <phase-slug> --stage close` runs after the closing verification and before the reviewer, and the reviewer does not start while it exits 1. Regenerate any generated host copies the repo checks for sync.
